summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: Portfolio Building Block US Banks ETF is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks to track the performance, before fees and expenses, of the BITA US Banking Select Index. The fund provides exposure to U.S. banking companies and is designed to track the performance of the U.S. banking sector. The ETF trades on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the ticker PBUB.
